items.title: Marshall Lawrence Interview, 1960-06-28
items.q: Did you, you knew Pierron? Pierron played the violin.

ctx.x: Oh yeah? We stayed on the road two months and nine days. But every, every, you see right here there was a dancing place. People from all over, New Orleans and Hammond. All over, used to ride at reserve every Saturday night, Sunday night there and dance. And we used to play there. We played there until we got tired. Used to get, they used to get big bands to play there all the time. Did you, you knew Pierron? Pierron played the violin.
